messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: Svc PROD-CATALOG - model-config-mismatch (severity: high)

pagerduty: Incident triggered by metric threshold 'catalog.config.errors' > 5m at 2024-03-05T09:01:39Z

maria.nguyen: acked — jumping in. seeing surge of 500s from /v1/models/*/infer starting ~09:00 UTC. correlates with catalog promotion job that finished at 08:58.

chris.patel: thanks. can you paste the promoted rev id? i pulled a couple stack traces and they look like tokenizer errors.

maria.nguyen: promoted rev: model:redwood-llama2-13b@rev:20240305-07
error snippet from proxy logs: `TokenizationError: incompatible tokenizer: expected vocab size 50257 got 51200`

maria.nguyen: quick glance at catalog entry shows tokenizer=sentencepiece and defaults.max_tokens=4096 (old model used 2048). that mismatch likely causing upstream codepath to try to allocate different kv cache sizes.

chris.patel: oh — the promotion pipeline should have validated tokenizer metadata. looks like the model bundle came with a different tokenizer than the catalog entry we authored in the promotion commit.

devon.lee: tagging infra/sig-runtime for visibility — this will cause OOM/KV-cache errors in runtime. @devon.lee taking lead on mitigation?

maria.nguyen: taking immediate mitigation: pinning route for service 'public-text-gen' to previous stable rev (20240220-14) and disabling auto-promote for that model id. command: 
```bash
# rollback route to stable
rwc routes update public-text-gen --model redwood-llama2-13b --rev 20240220-14 --force
```

chris.patel: applied rollback, route update returned 200. new traffic reports show error rate dropping within a minute.

pagerduty: 1712349999 - Incident acknowledged by maria.nguyen at 2024-03-05T09:05:12Z

maria.nguyen: confirming: errors down from ~4.7% -> 0.3% over last 3m post-rollback. latency for large prompts still elevated for a short tail, but no new 5xx.

devon.lee: good. next step: stop the promoted revision in catalog so no automatic traffic will be sent and open a hotfix PR to add tokenizer validation to promotion pipeline. who wants to own the PR?

chris.patel: i'll file the PR and include unit + integration check that compares model_bundle.tokenizer_vocab_size to catalog.tokenizer.expected_vocab_size. i'll also add a fail-fast check in the deployment job.

maria.nguyen: customer impact note: Hosted customers in us-west-2 on the public-text-gen route experienced increased 5xxs from 09:00-09:06 UTC. rough estimate: 3% of requests in that window returned 5xx, affecting ~6k requests total. known customers hitting the route: AcmeCorp (prod), Fitly (staging). no SLA breaches yet, but matt from account execs asked for a short blameless summary.

chris.patel: opened GH issue: rwc#4821 "promotion: validate tokenizer metadata before promote" and pushed branch `fix/promo-tokenizer-check`. linking in ticket: https://git.internal/rwc/rwc/issues/4821

maria.nguyen: created incident timeline + short customer impact note in ops/incidents/2024-03-05-catalog-promotion-tokenizer-mismatch.md (will attach logs and mitigation commands).

devon.lee: are there any other routes referencing the promoted rev? we should scan for active pins and temporary overrides.

maria.nguyen: running quick query: `rwc catalog search --rev 20240305-07 --references` -> returns 4 routes, two of which are internal-only. pinned ones: none. only public-text-gen was auto-switched.

chris.patel: rolled back & disabled auto-promote. i'll also add an alert to watch for tokenizer mismatch errors in proxy logs (log pattern match -> alert).

maria.nguyen: handing off to devon for post-incident follow-up and on-call coverage. devon, i'll add the postmortem template and assign owners for fix+validation.

devon.lee: taking handoff. i'll schedule a quick sync with runtime and infra tomorrow 09:30 UTC. i'll confirm customers contacted if necessary. assigned followups: @chris.patel (promo validation PR), @maria.nguyen (incident blurb + timeline), @runtime-team (investigate KV-cache handling for unexpected tokenizer sizes).

pagerduty: Incident resolved by maria.nguyen at 2024-03-05T09:12:08Z — Service returned to baseline.

maria.nguyen: closing notes: root cause = promoted model bundle had tokenizer vocab size that didn't match catalog metadata; promotion pipeline didn't validate tokenizer metadata; mitigation = immediate route rollback + disable auto-promote; next steps = add validation, add log-based alert, write runbook for tokenizer mismatch. will keep this thread updated with PR link and postmortem. :white_check_mark:

chris.patel: thumbs up. also adding a temporary regression test to our promotion pipeline job to run a lightweight tokenization roundtrip across small sample prompts before allowing promotion.

devon.lee: thanks team — handing over to followups. leaving for oncall rotation.

maria.nguyen: leaving note for next oncall: if you see repeated tokenizer errors after a promotion, do not re-promote; rollback routes and open a catalog audit.

(reacted :eyes: by devon.lee, :white_check_mark: by chris.patel)
